rationale: FROG has gapped up 27.3% on massive relative volume (8.93x) with no news context available, making the catalyst and sustainability of the move unclear. Price is at 89% of today's range near the session high ($99.00), suggesting exhaustion risk for a long, but the strong upward momentum and risk-off environment (VIXY -5.37%, SPY +0.80%) make a short equally dangerous. With three working short orders already consuming 9% of buying power and no clear mechanical edge in either direction on this volatile, news-driven gap, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure.
